name: CO2 to concrete and aggregates
principle: CO2 is injected into concrete during mixing, where it mineralises and raises compressive strength, allowing less cement. CarbonCure reports more than 500,000 t of CO2 saved over 7.5 million truckloads, with hundreds of systems in more than two dozen countries.

performance.metric: CO2 saved by CarbonCure to the date of the article
performance.basis: 7.5 million truckloads; date not stated in text read
